steps.name: persist-exact-65-control-source-checkpoint
steps.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
bt=chr(96)
c=Path('docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-native-control-census.md')
s=c.read_text()
assert '**66 = 56 przycisków + 10 input**, w **31 plikach**' in s
assert '22 zwykłe przyciski' in s
s=s.replace('d4485ad76fdcf9b03d39270344e6df2561b86f81','bc0b1a9e806c080648d635943e2ce5bd3f17f4f6',1)
s=s.replace('**66 = 56 przycisków + 10 input**, w **31 plikach**','**65 = 55 przycisków + 10 input**, w **30 plikach**',1)
s=s.replace('22 zwykłe przyciski','21 zwykłych przycisków',1)
lines=[];removed=0
for line in s.splitlines():
 if line.startswith('|') and 'features/plugs/components/PlugDeleteConfirmModal.tsx' in line:
  removed+=1;continue
 lines.append(line)
assert removed==1,removed
s='\n'.join(lines).rstrip()+'\n'
s+='\n## Zatwierdzony checkpoint — 2026-10-11, Plug Delete IonButton\n\n'
s+='Commit produktu '+bt+'bc0b1a9e806c080648d635943e2ce5bd3f17f4f6'+bt+' kończy migrację przycisku potwierdzenia usunięcia Pluga. Ochrony identyfikacji, fizycznego safe-OFF i trwałe rekordy nie zostały zmienione.\n\n'
s+='65 natywnych kontrolek: 55 przycisków, 10 pól Climate, w 30 plikach. 21 zwykłych akcji pozostaje do rozpatrzenia; 34 celowe przyciski i 10 pól Climate są chronione kontraktem UX.\n'
c.write_text(s)
note='\n## Verified latest Plug Delete Ionic checkpoint — 2026-10-11\n\n'
note+='Product HEAD '+bt+'bc0b1a9e806c080648d635943e2ce5bd3f17f4f6'+bt+': the guarded Plug deletion confirmation now uses IonButton with unchanged onConfirm and Cancel behavior; safety and i18n tests included. Focused modal unit tests **9/9 PASS**. Full '+bt+'pnpm check'+bt+' **PASS**, including **555/555** mobile tests. Canonical Darwin responsive/visual Playwright **50/50 PASS**, 0 skipped, 0 unexpected, 0 flaky, **no snapshot updates**. '+bt+'cap sync android'+bt+' and Gradle '+bt+'assembleDebug'+bt+' **PASS**, APK **5,179,520 B**, SHA-256 '+bt+'a5283ed32fb042a7fa66e322e93cae9d3d17a0545cd1c73baf71c41f436ba5cd'+bt+'. No phone or live Shelly operation performed. Main unchanged.\n\n'
note+='Native app controls: **65 = 55 native buttons + 10 frozen Climate inputs**, over 30 TSX files; 21 ordinary buttons, 34 intentionally custom. Hard JS budget passes; performance review is open (JS **2,370,425 B**, largest **1,043,584 B**, CSS **154,517 B**, 20 JS chunks). Headless emulator has not booted successfully; TalkBack/overlay/keyboard Android sign-off and intermittent native Capacitor background triggerEvent error remain open.\n'
for file in ('docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-independent-audit.md','docs/CHECKPOINT_2026-10-08_UX_EVOLUTION.md','docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md'):
 p=Path(file);t=p.read_text()
 assert '## Verified latest Plug Delete Ionic checkpoint — 2026-10-11' not in t
 p.write_text(t.rstrip()+'\n'+note)
PY
pnpm exec prettier --write docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-native-control-census.md docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-independent-audit.md docs/CHECKPOINT_2026-10-08_UX_EVOLUTION.md docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md
pnpm exec prettier --check docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-native-control-census.md docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-independent-audit.md docs/CHECKPOINT_2026-10-08_UX_EVOLUTION.md docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git add docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-native-control-census.md docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-independent-audit.md docs/CHECKPOINT_2026-10-08_UX_EVOLUTION.md docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md
git commit -m "docs(ionic): record fully accepted Plug delete and 65 native controls"
git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/work/ux-evolution
echo "CHECKPOINT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
git status --short
